scope: One bounded measurement-interface revision; no external mechanism claim or model computation

budget.development_sensor_access: Necessary neighbouring sensor observations only; metadata and source code may be inspected globally. No new qualification RGB/labels before prerequisite and final freeze.
versions: V1: verified coordinate/time chain with single-scan support
V2: same chain with one fixed motion-compensated local window
budget.window_rule: Provisional symmetric +/-0.5 seconds; at most 11 nearest scan times, sorted chronologically. Must be verified and frozen on development observations before new qualification acquisition. No window search on qualification.

cost.denominator: Full requested corridor area, represented by equal-area samples; never renormalize over known/evaluable area
cost.uncertainty_scope: Conditional empirical geometry-error analysis, not a coverage or physical-navigation guarantee
cost.unknown: Void, sky, unmapped IDs, unsupported, occluded, dynamically inconsistent, or geometrically uncertain samples

corridors.origin: Current LiDAR centre; gravity-aligned forward/left/up directions must be verified
corridors.prefix: 0-6 m is outside the task; no safe arrival or full route claim

prerequisites_before_new_samples.correspondence_table: RGB timestamp -> scan ID/time and within-scan timing convention -> pose ID/time -> named coordinate transformations -> current-camera projection
prerequisites_before_new_samples.pose_identity: Official export provenance plus observational verification, or timestamped raw pose/IMU chain; no image-ID/pose-row guess or count-only inference
prerequisites_before_new_samples.calibration: Versioned intrinsics, distortion, extrinsics, sensor/body axes and gravity source must be consistent; independently check observed alignment
prerequisites_before_new_samples.independent_observations: Use necessary development-neighbour scans withheld from fitting. Split deterministic chronological neighbour ranks into fit and check observations before their geometry is inspected; preserve errors even if large.
prerequisites_before_new_samples.false_support: Check terrain breaks, foreground occlusion and inferred ground under non-ground objects; nearby points or depth bins alone are insufficient
prerequisites_before_new_samples.error_envelope: Freeze a measured empirical range for timing/registration, surface height and projection from independent development checks before qualification; propagate jointly into full-area cost intervals. Do not invent arbitrary perturbations as measured error.
prerequisites_before_new_samples.information_rights: Neighbour/future scans are privileged offline reference only. Current-camera visibility must hold. No future input enters future RGB selector or acceptance. Human semantic labels never fit ground, choose windows or fill holes.
prerequisites_before_new_samples.failure: If mapping, coordinates, independent support/error evidence or spatial isolation cannot be substantiated within the bounded route, stop before acquiring fresh qualification samples. Budget is an upper bound, not a requirement to exhaust it.

fresh_qualification.selection: After verified global/route geometry, partition and merge revisits using metadata only. Exclude the entire support footprint of development, including the earlier engineering-example exclusion. Apply >=25 m spatial separation including uncertainty and all support scans. Freeze exactly 12 route/spatial blocks and 4 timestamp-spaced centres per block, ordered deterministically, before reading any new RGB/labels. If 12 defensibly isolated blocks cannot be formed, stop; do not substitute sequence IDs for spatial evidence.
fresh_qualification.identity_freeze: A second signed-by-hash machine record must contain all 48 centre IDs, all support scan IDs, spatial block assignment, uncertainty settings and human review IDs; this protocol alone is not a claim that those identities exist
fresh_qualification.human_review: Preselect first and third chronological centres in first six ordered blocks (12 frames across six blocks). Independent human reviewer must assess new support, boundaries and discontinuities; assistant inspection is additional evidence, never represented as human review.
fresh_qualification.missing_policy: Keep missing, failed, unknown and all-noncompliant samples; no replacement
fresh_qualification.consumption: Qualification is development evidence, never reused for final mechanism confirmation

decision.systematic_false_support_changing_labels: Fail even if average coverage passes
decision.full_pass: All prerequisites, human review, decision evaluability/information and continuous-cost precision pass
decision.binary_only_pass: All prerequisites, human review and decision evaluability/information pass but continuous-cost precision fails; only accepted danger rate and availability may be studied subsequently, no continuous regret or residual-mechanism validation
decision.fail_or_uncertain: Stop external expansion and narrow controlled-case manuscript. No automatic third repair or new sample search.
decision.reporting: All frames and evaluable subset, per block, all-compliant/mixed/none-compliant/undetermined, geometry/support/error causes, and semantic/geometric characteristics of excluded scenes. These counts are engineering/information gates, not significance or safety guarantees.
